original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi, c, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC WITH wi, collect({company: c.companyName, count: cnt})[0..5] AS topCompanies RETURN wi.workItemCode, topCompanies ORDER BY wi.workItemCode LIMIT 5
paths_SQL: SELECT r.node_id rn,r.resolutionId,t.node_id tn,t.tdocNumber,w.node_id wn,w.workItemCode,c.node_id cn,c.companyName FROM Resolution r JOIN rel_REFERENCES e ON e.src_id=r.node_id JOIN Tdoc t ON t.node_id=e.dst_id JOIN rel_RELATED_TO rw ON rw.src_id=t.node_id JOIN WorkItem w ON w.node_id=rw.dst_id JOIN rel_SUBMITTED_BY sc ON sc.src_id=t.node_id JOIN Company c ON c.node_id=sc.dst_id
